role: Mechanical Design Engineer — Gearbox & Rotating Equipment

Executing environmental compliance material substitution (seals, O-rings, thread-locking compounds) per Wärtsilä-approved specifications, with full revision traceability across affected drawings and MTO.

Managing engineering documentation release through Teamcenter, maintaining revision control integrity across all modified drawings, BOMs, and procurement-linked MTO packages.

Prepared assembly-level BOMs and fabrication drawings per ISO standards to support procurement and manufacturing readiness.
